title: Raw agent stdout event
description: One JSONL line from agent.stdout.jsonl. Event-specific payloads remain open, while common join keys are documented and validated.

type.description: Event discriminator such as thread.started, turn.started, item.completed, turn.completed, or token usage update.

turn_id.description: Turn join key used to batch assistant messages and tool calls.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort reported by this event.

item.description: Message, command, tool result, file change, or task status payload. Preserve the complete payload.

usage.description: Runner-native usage update. It may be cumulative and must be deduplicated before run totals are calculated.
